verdict.rationale: Convex's own documented auth capability is a Custom Auth Integration that accepts any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider, and its docs point to Clerk, Auth0, and WorkOS AuthKit ("built for B2B apps"). That gives a documented OIDC path for enterprise SSO. The built-in Convex Auth library covers only social providers, one-time email/SMS codes, and passwords. MFA enforcement and SAML are not documented as Convex features; they would depend on the external identity provider. Missing for 10: any documented MFA requirement or enforcement, SAML support, a first-party enterprise SSO policy in Convex itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
